title: LinhX Crawl Server (Waterfall Crawler)
summary: A high-performance, multi-tier web crawling service implementing a 'Waterfall' fallback pattern (httpx → Crawl4AI → Firecrawl → Playwright). It provides structured markdown extraction, batch processing, and sitemap discovery while remaining 100% self-hosted. Successfully applied to scan real-world event hubs for the TUNG TA TUNG TANG project, proving its effectiveness on complex sites like Ticketbox and Hanoigrapevine.
